samples.marker_line: 0C 0.2.3: local IME and signed updates; traits retained
evidence: All 966 source files shared with the forager-recovered upstream v0.2.3 archive are byte-identical. Only SOURCE-RELEASE.json and eight dictionary data/manifests/notices are release additions. Release manifest identifies commit 862bd80bb5c435b68b98345d3497ae5279ebef71.

TSF service dispatches IME events and privacy checks to the composition engine. Its langbar worker exchanges framed menu/status messages over local named pipes. CreateThread executes an internal callback while retaining the DLL with GetModuleHandleEx and releasing it with FreeLibraryAndExitThread; no remote injection.

The engine server handles bounded session requests over a per-user Unix socket or Windows pipe. Optional vocabulary HTTP service binds loopback and checks bearer token, Host and Origin. Neural worker is local. No typed-text exfiltration found in the reviewed input paths.

Updater VerifySignedFeed checks Ed25519 signatures before parsing, expiry, serial rollback, product/channel and HTTPS asset declarations. Package update/download, execution, crypto and permission capabilities remain notable.

update_e2e.py installs test builds, creates test services and drives Fcitx/Xvfb in a documented resettable account; test_release.py exercises packaging/rejection/rollback in temporary directories. candidate.rs renders UI. These match their stated development purposes.
samples.classifier_disagreement: ML still falsely convicts authentic source/test tooling.

samples.identity: dotnet/arcade @main source archive and signing-test resources
samples.marker_line: Arcade: inert signing fixtures; DLL/EXE mismatch retained
evidence: Isolated atomscan purl pkg:github/dotnet/arcade@main recovers SHA256 b75886664cdc4dd49e1577e3f81499db127d38b805a7a56d2b78b95898c8edbc, exactly the supplied archive; before/after scans have identical findings.
SignToolTests.cs FilesAreUniqueByName explicitly loads SameFiles1.zip and SameFiles2.zip to check content/name collision behavior, without executing the resources.

Simple1.exe and Simple2.exe have identical SHA256 dcd5a867480fee469a37ff890446f4a34b7770edde4dd939a0313f1d3b3aaf99, DLL characteristics 0x2022, no managed entrypoint, and a single constructor whose IL calls Object..ctor and returns.

The suspicious DLL-image/EXE-name trait correctly describes those actual headers and names. Retain it without a package/dependency exception. Six descendant occurrences include nested ZIP rollups and inert PE members; the root has one distinct suspicious trait.

Repository build/test/signing and CI workflows account for program execution, downloads, certificates and archive operations. ClamAV flag alone supplies no hostile execution path or proof of compromise.

samples.marker_line: NanoCoreUltimate: keylog theft and ransom attempts; AV rules fixed
evidence: CLR entrypoint 0x0600001d resolves to Program.Main, which creates and hides working directories, launches surveillance tasks, installs persistence and attempts system/security interference without a consent flow.

StartKeylogger installs WH_KEYBOARD_LL; HookCallback records timestamped keystrokes in _keylog; FlushKeylog base64-encodes KEYLOG records and passes them to SendToC2, which appends local logs and calls WebClient.UploadString to http://cakhiatvx.cc. Polling recorder is also present.

Clipboard state machine reads clipboard contents and forwards records. ContinuousScreenshot captures PrimaryScreen with CopyFromScreen, saves JPEGs and forwards base64 SCREEN records. File enumerators read local files and send truncated/base64 FILE/SCRAPED records. Browser Login Data/Cookies are read; Microsoft/Credentials files are copied into staging.

InstallPersistence writes HKCU/HKLM Run values, copies the executable to Startup, creates on-logon and recurring tasks. MorePersistence sets RunOnce. A PDF association redirects open commands to this executable. USB routines copy self and write autorun.inf.

BypassUAC writes the ms-settings open-command default to self, sets empty DelegateExecute, starts fodhelper.exe, then schedules registry cleanup. DeleteShadowCopies launches vssadmin and WMIC deletion. Other routines delete SafeBoot, stop Defender/security/update services, disable firewall and hijack tool execution with IFEO.

DisableDefenderPowerShell constructs Set-MpPreference monitoring-disable and Add-MpPreference path-exclusion commands, converts UTF-16 bytes to Base64, and starts extensionless powershell with a separate -NoP -NonI -W Hidden -Exec Bypass -Enc argument string. This is the concrete missing coverage repaired here.

RealEncryption recursively targets Desktop/TestFolder, reads bytes, attempts AES encryption, writes a .encrypted sibling and deletes the original after a successful write. AES_IV is 14 bytes, so set_IV fails; catches suppress failure. Ransom notes, wallpaper and input-lockout attempts are still hostile. Existing encryption-attempt traits are accurate.

UpdateActiveWindow invokes user32!GetWindowMock, a nonexistent export, and catches exceptions. Foreground-title capture is not established; dotnet-keylogger-window-title-profile remains absent. Do not restore the real GetWindowText-based predicate.

ProcessInjection writes a one-byte RET stub into notepad remote memory and creates a thread. Retain neutral remote-thread API detection; no functional injected payload, hollowing or RAT command dispatcher is established. NetworkSpread names only localhost/127.0.0.1 administrative shares; do not infer cross-host SMB propagation. Debugger and thread-hide APIs are declarations without calls in the reviewed IL.

Numerous malware-family mutexes, misleading method names and planted keyword arrays do not establish family attribution. The verdict rests on reachable collection-to-upload paths and system interference. No deployment authorization or runtime success was supplied.
samples.classifier_disagreement: No verdict disagreement; two missing Defender hostile behaviors are now covered.
